description:
Checkpoint a milestone or handoff for later recovery with engram_rehydrate. Supply at least one of summary, learnings, used_memories or feedback. Returns Markdown with stored/skipped counts, outcomes and next actions. Use engram_store for one lesson and engram_report_outcome for one outcome.

store=false skips learning storage only: the journal and supplied outcomes/feedback can still be written. This checkpoint leaves the session open. Retrying may duplicate writes; verify prior success first. Consumes workspace daily call quota and memory quota for saved lessons. OAuth: session:write, memory:write and outcome:write.

agent_tool.description: Calling client name for attribution, e.g. codex, claude-code, cursor, or gemini. Omit if unknown.

feedback.description: Optional product feedback or feedback-pulse dismissal; separate from outcomes about individual memories.

dismiss.description: True permanently dismisses the optional weekly feedback pulse for this agent member.

notes.description: Concrete non-sensitive feedback explaining the selected signal.

signal.description: Quality of Engram retrieval during this work; omit if only dismissing the feedback pulse.

learnings.description: Durable private workspace lessons to persist when store=true; only the first 8 are processed. Low-quality entries may be skipped. The summary remains a journal checkpoint.

content.description: One durable, self-contained lesson, up to 20,000 characters. State the decision/fix and why it matters; exclude secrets and transient debug logs.

context.description: Non-sensitive supporting metadata, e.g. {language: "typescript", component: "auth"}; never credentials or raw customer data.

tags.description: Topic labels for storing or filtering memory; omit when no useful labels apply.

items.description: Searchable topic label, e.g. oauth or postgres.

type.description: Knowledge category: team rule, reusable pattern, pitfall, proven fix, design decision, or library/version quirk.

repo.description: Repository slug, e.g. engram or billing-api, within the authenticated workspace. This is a memory filter, not a filesystem path or workspace selector.

session_id.description: Exact journal id from start/rehydrate/list_sessions. Disambiguates parallel work; writing requires your active session. Rehydrate may read shared or closed history.

store.description: Default true saves accepted durable learnings; false skips learning storage only. Session checkpoints, supplied outcomes and feedback are still recorded.

summary.description: Milestone/handoff summary: what changed, evidence, decisions and remaining work. Required unless learnings, outcomes or feedback are supplied.

task.description: Concrete current goal or decision, e.g. diagnose checkout retries; used to focus context and session recovery.

used_memories.description: Outcomes for memories actually used during this milestone; only the first 20 are processed. Omit when none were applied.

detail.description: Brief evidence of how the memory changed the decision, or why it failed. Exclude secrets.

failure_reason.description: Why an unsuccessful memory failed; outdated marks obsolete knowledge. Omit for a successful use.

memory_id.description: Exact id from a recalled memory; do not substitute a repository name, URL, or the memory text.

success.description: Whether this memory helped the actual task: true for a useful application, false for a misleading or unusable result.

name: engram_reflect

format.description: Payload encoding: Markdown context/checkpoint, serialized JSON data, or plain confirmation text.

text.description: The same bounded payload as content[0].text; interpret it using format. JSON text contains the endpoint-specific fields described by this tool.

truncated.description: True when the payload exceeded 120,000 characters and was cut with a notice. Narrow the request; truncated JSON is not parseable.
